commonDirection: One nearly square full-bleed LORE illustration. Use the current art for brushwork, atmospheric planes and expressive silhouettes. Keep key forms within the central 75%. No framing, typography, glossy rendering or photographic detail.

subjects.ELITE_GOBLIN: Veteran forest goblin in a bronze half-helm, bracing with a worn shield on a mossy bridge.
subjects.MINI_SPIRIT: A tiny blue spirit curling around a freestanding brass Attune crystal ring in the library.
subjects.MANA_HEART: A heart-shaped mana crystal held by ruby and brass ribs over a stone altar.
subjects.FORTIFY_CASTLE: Castle defense: a broad interlocking wall of ivory kite shields at the base of a citadel, iron brace sliding into place, cobalt morning light.
subjects.SIEGE_CASTLE: Siege: close view of empty ram mid-impact against a fractured bastion gate, sunlit airborne limestone and red heraldic pennants.
subjects.SECRET_OF_STRENGTH: Strengthening secret: old iron gauntlet and breastplate on an empty armorer bench, a luminous silver inlay spreading across both.
subjects.MUSTER_DIE: Conscription: a worn ivory die settling against ordered rows of pewter soldier tokens on an indigo tactical cloth.
subjects.COUP: Coup: an overturned brass crown, reversed royal colors unfurling over an abandoned throne, deep burgundy and pale gold.
subjects.CAPTAIN: One decisive naval infantry captain on a windy ivory citadel tower, navy greatcoat, red sash, elegant swept tricorne, arm giving the order to fire, readable three-quarter silhouette.
subjects.CANNON_COMMANDER: Veteran master of artillery standing between the immense weathered bronze silhouettes of two fantasy cannons, pale military cape, strong low angle.
subjects.QUICK_ESCORT: Escort guard spell: a compact wall of blue and silver heraldic shields standing together in front of an illuminated castle entrance.
subjects.WANTED: Wanted notice: a royal seal pinning a faceless silhouette sketch to dark oak with one sharp dagger, ochre lantern light, no legible writing.
subjects.ESSENCE_OF_LIFE: Essence of Life: an ancient glass terrarium filled with pale roots, its silver binding closing over a fading amethyst spark.
subjects.MARKET_FEVER: Market fever: cobalt market awnings over a counter of traded enchanted wares, tokens suspended mid-exchange, late amber light.
subjects.SHARED_MARKET: Persistent marketplace: a broad arcade of empty merchant stalls and a suspended brass balance with paired coins tipping over white marble.
subjects.DRAGON_KILLER: A single dragon hunter in battered brass-scaled armor with a long split-headed lance, a vast dragon wing shadow behind him on a pale ravine wall.
subjects.QUICK_INSURANCE: Finishing strike spell: a hairline fracture on the last remaining link of an enchanted chain as a second tiny silver bolt strikes.
subjects.ATTUNE_LOCK: Attune Lock: a bound blue floating Attune crystal with six brass clasps pulling its concentric rings shut, muted red shadows.
subjects.ATTUNE_DISSECTION: Attune Dissection: exploded-view crystal layers suspended between brass arcane calipers above an inked slate, mineral cross sections lit from within.
subjects.ATTUNE_RETURN: Attune Return: one sapphire crystal rising out of open parchment folds and slipping toward its empty circular mounting.
subjects.SPIRIT_RESONANCE: Spirit Resonance: a small blue teardrop-shaped spirit emerging from the reflection of a brass astral ring over rippling water.
subjects.DUAL_ATTUNE: Dual Attune: two equal crystals facing across paired concentric armillary rings, pale waves of light repeating the same motion.
subjects.ATTUNE_MANAFLOW: Attune Manaflow: a ribbon of azure liquid mana winding through copper aqueducts into a crystalline tuning fork.
subjects.ATTUNE_SECRET: Secret of Attune: a partially open crystal iris revealing a bright hidden facet within an old celestial instrument.
subjects.ATTUNE_RESEARCH: Attune Research: three unequal light pulses traveling through a blue crystal prism on a well used brass-and-parchment study bench.
subjects.ATTUNE_SHINE: Attune Shine: a faceted sapphire suspended in a library oculus, a radiant fan of sharp silver light washing across a dark floor.
subjects.QUEST_ATTUNE_STUDY: Attune scholarship: an open illuminated folio and eight blue gemstones arranged along the spiral of a brass instrument.
subjects.SWORD_GRAVE_WRAITH: A single spectral swordmaster haunting a moss-covered field of broken sword grave markers. Moon-white translucent cloak, long sword held vertically, dignified and colossal.
subjects.FATE_WRAITH: A defiant dark specter, snapped golden fate threads falling through its open spectral hands, deep violet drapery, aged pale mask split down the middle.
subjects.TIME_WRAITH: A single time-lost wraith stepping through layers of a ruined arch seen in three ages at once; tarnished brass rings and spectral turquoise, strong silhouette.
